title: Touring Switzerland and meeting Hans Zurbrugg's Wolverines at Nice
summary: After a cultural tour twenty years earlier, he is booked by George Wein with a Swiss Dixieland band at Nice and fits in without asking them to learn his songs.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: And, it was a lovely tour; it was the

first time I had ever seen Switzerland, but this time - when I went back - I had played for George Wein in Nice and, of course, George always puts things on the bulletin board everyday where you're suppose to appear and the second thing I did in that-- of that particular day, I think it was the second day of the concert thing, I was to play with Hans Zurbrugg's Wolverines; of course, I've never even heard of them let alone play with them. So, I went down there and stood around and they're playing and they were a very good sounding Dixie Land type band; they played a little swing and they played a little - sort of some - occasionally little Ellington pieces and things like that. So, he saw me standing there and I told him I had to appear with him. So, I did. And, of course, they have some arrangements in the band and what they couldn't figure out is how I fit right in and did the thing with them because I didn't ask them to play my songs - I said, just go ahead and play and I'll play with you, which I did.
You just fit yourself in with them?
